sourceRefs.locator: pp. 69–73, introduction and “The itinerary of Alaric”: campaign in Achaea in 396, Athens, Corinth and the disagreements among ancient accounts.
V.5–7: Alaric in southern Greece, Athens and passage to the Peloponnese.

summary.de: Athen und Korinth stehen für zwei lokal unterschiedliche Erfahrungen mit dem Feldzug in der römischen Provinz Achaia. Ihre archäologischen Befunde lassen sich getrennt betrachten.
summary.en: Athens and Corinth had distinct local experiences of the campaign in Roman Achaea. Their archaeological records can be examined separately.
